verdict.rationale: Apple's spec page publishes some concrete figures: a 10-core GPU, a 16-core Neural Engine and 153GB/s memory bandwidth. The newsroom also states a 32GB memory capacity. Most of the newsroom material, however, uses marketing adjectives such as "dramatically accelerated" rather than measurable specs. The only clock evidence is a community leak inferring "same max clock speed", not a vendor figure. Missing for 10: vendor-published CPU/GPU clock speeds, power/TDP figures, an AI TOPS rating, and test conditions for any performance claim.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can comparison-shop from a real spec sheet — the vendor publishes clocks, power, memory support, and AI TOPS with test conditions, instead of marketing adjectives
